BOOK A CONSULTATION Our Team Our team of medical and administrative professionals is what makes our About Face — A Well Labs+ Medspa such a special place, and they are the reason why our clients keep coming back. Take a moment to meet them all below! Ericka McCarron, RN, President Ericka McCarron is the owner and founder of About Face Medical Aesthetics, NH’s leading aesthetics practice. A registered nurse since 2001 and specializing in plastics and aesthetics since 2005, Ericka has extensive knowledge of the human face and how it ages. Her advanced injection training, years of experience, gentle touch, and aesthetic eye draw patients to the practice and keep them coming back. Ericka has been a faculty member of Allergan Medical Institute (AMI) since 2011, training physicians and mid-level providers on technique, safety, and application of Botox® Cosmetic , Juvéderm® Collection of Dermal Fillers , Coolsculpting® , and Kybella®. Additionally, as a Certified Master of Coolsculpting, she has advanced training and years of Coolsculpting experience. This allows her to apply the highest level of skill and knowledge when treating our Coolsculpting® body contouring patients. Ericka travels frequently throughout the U.S., collaborating with colleagues and immersing herself in her trade to provide the most cutting-edge products and techniques to her patients. She is an active member of the International Society of Plastic and Aesthetic Nurses (ISPAN), American Academy of Medical Esthetic Professionals (AAMEP), and International Nurses Association (INA). Ericka loves spending time with her children, Devyn and Colin, family, and friends. Christine Michelson, APRN, Medical Director Christine was an intensive care nurse before studying at UNH to earn her master’s degree and become a nurse practitioner. Christine became the medical director for our team in 2016 and also serves as a hospitalist at Exeter Hospital. She previously worked as a strength and conditioning coach, helping clients meet their health and fitness goals. Christine’s time off is spent with her dog Marley or traveling the world. Delaney Grant, BSN, RN Delaney graduated Magna Cum Laude with her Bachelor’s in Nursing from Clemson University in 2019. She began her nursing career in intensive care, before transitioning into labor and delivery in early 2021. Delaney’s passion has always been in medical aesthetics. She received her certification in neurotoxin and dermal filler from the Audrey Rose Institute, completed Allergan’s Accelerate Program under the direction of Dr. Young Cho., and has trained extensively with owner and expert injector Ericka McCarron. Delaney is thrilled to be providing services to our valued patients. In her free time, Delaney loves spending time with her family. Jennifer Leblanc, LNA, LNA & Lead Body Contouring Specialist Jennifer Leblanc, LNA is About Face Medical Aesthetics’ lead Certified Coolsculpting Specialist and Emculpt Neo Provider. Jen is an advanced phlebotomist and has a huge passion for helping individuals look and feel their best while using her multifaceted skills to elevate the patient experience. In March of 2022 Jen became a faculty member for the Allergan Medical Institute. In this role she has become a national Coolsculpting trainer. Jen enjoys sharing her love, knowledge, and passion of Coolsculpting. Prior to making the leap into Aesthetics, Jen was an LNA/Unit Coordinator at Exeter Hospital for 15 years with my primary focus in Progressive Care. In 2008 she was nominated by peers as LNA of the year and attended an award ceremony at the State House for exemplary patient care and leadership skills. Outside of the office Jen enjoys reading with her book club, and spending time with her husband Brad, and daughter Bianca. Samantha Fuller, Director of Operations & Human Resources Samantha is passionate about driving positive change and growth for individuals and business teams. With multiple years of experience in professional executive assistant positions, she provides high-level administrative support for her colleagues. Samantha received her Bachelor’s in Marketing from the University of Massachusetts, Amherst. She continues to utilize those skillsets in various elements of her current role including assisting in marketing the common vision for excellence at About Face Medical Aesthetics. Samantha resides on the beautiful NH Seacoast. She is happiest when she is enjoying time with her three sons and working in her gardens. Devyn McCarron, Patient & Marketing Coordinator Devyn started her career at About Face Medical Aesthetics part time in 2018 while attending school at the University of New Hampshire. In 2019, after receiving her Bachelor of Science degree in Equine Studies, Devyn transitioned as a full-time patient coordinator working alongside her mom, Ericka. In addition to helping us offer our patients a one-of-a kind experience, Devyn also manages the practice’s social media accounts. In her off time, Devyn enjoys spending time with her animals! Makenzie Levesque, Clinical Coordinator Makenzie Levesque has been a valued member of the About Face Medical Aesthetics team since 2019. As About Face Medical Aesthetics’ Clinical Coordinator, she works closely with our nurses and nurse practitioner to ensure that each patient receives top-notch care and attention. With a strong commitment to patient comfort, Makenzie excels at creating a welcoming and relaxed environment, helping patients feel at ease during their treatments. Outside of her role at About Face Medical Aesthetics, Makenzie is a devoted mother to her two-and-a-half-year-old son, Rowen, and enjoys spending time with her family. When she’s not working, she loves training horses and pursuing her passion for equestrian activities. Her dedication to both her work and personal life reflects her compassionate nature, making her a cherished part of the About Face Medical Aesthetics team! Dr. Whitney Elsesser, DNP, CNM, Wellness Specialist Whitney plays an integral role at About Face Medical Aesthetics, specializing in women’s and men’s hormonal health and midlife wellness. She offers comprehensive hormone evaluations and individualized treatment plans to guide patients through life transitions, including perimenopause, menopause, and other hormone-related changes. Whitney brings nearly a decade of experience in reproductive and women’s health care. She combines evidence-based medicine with functional and integrative approaches to identify root causes rather than simply managing symptoms. Her clinical focus includes hormone balance, fatigue, weight changes, sleep concerns, mood fluctuations, and the impact hormones have on skin health and aging. Whitney is passionate about patient education and empowering patients to better understand their bodies. Her goal is to help individuals feel their best from the inside out by supporting overall wellness in combination with aesthetic treatments. Ainsley Mastin, Patient Care Coordinator Ainsley is a Patient Care Coordinator at About Face Medical Aesthetics and a rising senior in the nursing program at the University of New Hampshire. Passionate about healthcare and patient experience, she helps create a welcoming, supportive environment for every patient who walks through the door. Ainsley loves building connections with patients, ensuring each visit feels comfortable, positive, and personalized. She is excited to continue expanding her knowledge and hands-on experience as she works toward her future career in nursing! Outside of the office, Ainsley enjoys traveling and spending time with family and friends.
